title: BLOOD OF JESUS ARISE AND FIGHT FOR ME NOW
text: Oh, the blood of Jesus. The blood of Jesus. The blood of Jesus. Before I say anything tonight, before a single word of teaching comes forth, I want you to just open your mouth right where you are and begin to plead the blood. I don't care if you are in your room. I don't care if you are in your car. I don't care if it is 3:00 in the morning and the whole house is asleep. Open your mouth and say, "The blood of Jesus." Say it again. The blood of Jesus. Say it like you mean it. The blood of Jesus speaks for me tonight. Shand. Oh, the Holy Ghost is here. The Holy Ghost is here already. I can feel the weight of his presence. Something is about to shift in this place. Something is about to shift in your life. Father, we thank you. We thank you for what you are about to do. We thank you that you did not allow this moment to pass us by. We thank you that out of the millions of people on the earth tonight, you handpicked everyone hearing this voice and you said, "This one will encounter my blood." Thank you, Lord. Thank you, precious Holy Spirit. Now, listen, before we go further, I want you to do something for me. Share this message right now. Don't wait. Don't say you will do it later. There is someone in your contact list. There is someone on your timeline. And this is the word that will break the chain over their life. You may never know the full weight of what God will do through you by simply sharing this. The Bible says in Revelation 12:1, "And they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony." You are about to become a carrier of testimony to somebody's life. Send this now. Post it now. Be the instrument God uses tonight. Are we together? Now sit down in your spirit. Open your heart. What I am about to share with you is not ordinary. This is not a motivational talk. This is not religious entertainment. What you are about to hear is a prophetic unlocking and I need your full attention. Turn with me to Exodus 12-13. The Lord said, "For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast, and against all the gods of Egypt, I will execute judgment. I am the Lord. And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are. And when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you when I smite the land of Egypt." Did you hear that? Write it down. When I see the blood, I will pass over you. Now, look at Hebrews 12:4. The Bible says, "And to Jesus, the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaketh better things than that of Abel." Catch this. The blood speaks. The blood of Jesus is not silent. It is not a theological concept sitting somewhere in a seminary textbook. The blood of Jesus is a living, active, vocal, spiritual force and it is speaking right now on your behalf. Abel's blood cried out from the ground for vengeance. But the blood of Jesus speaks better things. It speaks mercy. It speaks redemption. It speaks protection. It speaks healing. It speaks deliverance. It speaks access. It speaks favor. And tonight we are going to activate that voice. Listen carefully. There are dimensions to the blood that many believers never access. Many of us know the blood for salvation. You came to an altar call. Somebody preached. They said the blood of Jesus was shed for your sins and you gave your life to Christ. That is wonderful. That is the foundation. But I need you to understand that salvation is only the gate. There are courts beyond the gate. There is a holy place beyond the outer court. And the blood that saved you is the same blood that fights for you. Let me say it again. The same blood that redeemed you is the same blood that goes to war on your behalf. You see, the enemy is not afraid of your shouting. The enemy is not afraid of your religious activities. The devil has sat through many prayer meetings unbothered. But there is one thing, one singular thing that makes every demon in hell tremble and that is the blood of the lamb. Colossians chapter 2 14 and 15 the Bible says he blotted out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us which was contrary to us and took it out of the way nailing it to his cross. And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it. How did he triumph? Through the cross, through the shedding of blood. The victory of Calvary was not a symbolic victory. It was a legal victory. It was a judicial verdict passed in the courts of heaven that rendered every satanic claim against your life null and void. But here's the problem. Many of God's children are living as though that verdict was never passed. The enemy keeps bringing up old files, old covenants, old sins, old altars. And instead of presenting the blood, we present our tears. Instead of presenting the blood, we present our fasting. Instead of presenting the blood, we present our own righteousness. And the enemy laughs because none of those things can override his legal claims. But the blood, the blood, when you present the blood, something happens in the realm of the spirit. The Bible calls it the court of heaven. And in that court, there is an advocate. 1 John 2:1, "My little children, these things write I unto you that ye sin not." And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the father, Jesus Christ the righteous. Your advocate does not argue your case with eloquent words. He argues your case with blood. He lifts up his hands and shows the scars. He presents the evidence of a finished work. And when the blood speaks, the judge of all the earth says, "Case dismissed." Thus said the spirit of God tonight. Every case opened against your life in the spirit realm by the presentation of the blood, that case is dismissed. I feel the anointing of the Holy Ghost right now. You know in the Old Testament the high priest could not enter the most holy place without blood. Leviticus chapter 16 very clear. He had to carry the blood of the sacrifice. If he entered without blood he died. The bells on his garment would stop ringing and the men outside would know judgment had fallen. But when he carried the blood the blood became his access, the blood became his protection. The blood became his covering. And the same God who required blood for access in the old covenant has provided blood, superior blood, eternal blood for your access in the new covenant. Hebrews 9 11-12. But Christ being come and high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building, neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood, he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us. Listen to me carefully. The blood of Jesus obtained eternal redemption, not temporary, not seasonal, not partial, eternal. That means the blood that was shed over 2,000 years ago is still fresh tonight. It has not dried up. It has not lost its potency. The blood of Jesus does not have an expiration date. Every time you plead it, it is as powerful as the moment it flowed from his side on Calvary. And you are going to plead it tonight like never before. There are dimensions to this. Let me give you the dimensions quickly because I want us to enter prayer. The blood of Jesus operates in at least seven dimensions and every dimension is a weapon. Number one, the blood speaks for your redemption. Ephesians 1:7, in whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins according to the riches of his grace. Whatever the enemy is using your past to hold you captive, the blood has already paid the ransom. Number two, the blood speaks for your justification. Romans 5:9, much more then being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him. Justified means just as if had never sinned. The blood does not just forgive, it removes the record entirely. The file does not exist anymore. Number three, the blood speaks for your peace. Colossians 1:20. and having made peace through the blood of his cross by him to reconcile all things unto himself. If you have been carrying anxiety, fear, confusion, restlessness, the blood of Jesus is your peace. The blood reconciles. The blood settles. The blood brings order to chaos. Number four, the blood speaks for your cleansing. 1 John chapter 1:7. But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another and the blood of Jesus Christ his son cleanseth us from all sin. Not some sin, all sin, every stain, every contamination, every pollution, from every wrong covenant, from every wrong relationship, from every wrong altar, the blood cleanses. Number five, the blood speaks for your access. Hebrews 10 19-20. Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus by a new and living way which he had consecrated for us through the veil, that is to say his flesh. You have boldness. You have access. You are not begging to enter. The blood has given you the legal right to stand before God. Number six, the blood speaks for your protection. Exodus 12:23, for the Lord will pass through to smite the Egyptians. And when he se the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the Lord will not suffer the destroyer to come in onto your houses to destroy you. When the blood is upon your life, your home, your family, the destroyer cannot enter. The destroyer sees the blood and passes over. Number seven, the blood speaks for your victory. Revelation 12 11, and they overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony. The blood is your weapon of war. When you enter spiritual warfare, you do not go unarmed. You carry the most potent substance in all of existence, the blood of the lamb. Now, this is why the title of this message is what it is, blood of Jesus. Arise and fight for me now. Because the blood fights. The blood has a voice. The blood has authority. And when you as a covenant child of God open your mouth and invoke the blood, something is activated in the spirit realm that cannot be stopped by any demon, any witch, any principality, any territorial power. I decree and declare over every life connected to this ministration tonight, the blood of Jesus arises on your behalf now in the name of Jesus. Every silent battle you have been fighting where you could not even explain what was happening. You just knew something was wrong, something was off, something was blocking you, something was following you. Tonight the blood arises as your champion, as your defender, as your advocate. Now I want us to pray. I am going to lead you into what I call a blood covenant prayer session. This is not casual. This is not ordinary. You are going to open your mouth and you are going to pray with everything in you. And as you pray, the Holy Ghost is going to back your words with fire. Some of you deliverance is going to happen tonight. Some of you chains that have been on your family for generations are going to break tonight. Some of you sicknesses that doctors have not been able to diagnose are going to leave your body tonight. I want you to believe. Position your faith. Here we go. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before your throne tonight. Not by my own merit, not by my own righteousness, but by the blood of the lamb. I present the blood of Jesus as my entry. I present the blood of Jesus as my plea. I present the blood of Jesus as my weapon. And I ask that as I pray, the blood will speak, the blood will fight, and the blood will prevail in the name of Jesus Christ. Now, lift your voice and pray this with me. Say, "Blood of Jesus, arise and speak for me in every realm where my name is being mentioned for evil." Say it. Pray it. Mean it. In the courts of darkness where your name has been placed on an altar. In the coven meetings where your destiny has been discussed. In the circles of wickedness where verdicts have been passed against your life. The blood of Jesus arises now and overrules every verdict. The blood of Jesus arises now and silences every evil tongue. The blood of Jesus arises now and dismantles every demonic agenda. I speak to every evil altar that is active against your life tonight. Whether it is an altar in your father's house, whether it is an altar in your mother's village, whether it is an altar that was raised when you were dedicated as a child to a god you never chose, whether it is an altar built through sexual covenants, whether it is an altar built through blood covenants, whether it is an altar that was erected over your family line generations before you were born, I command the blood of Jesus to visit that altar right now. And I say by the power of the living God, every evil altar ministering against your destiny, catch fire in the name of Jesus, catch fire, burn to ashes. Let the blood of Jesus consume every sacrifice placed upon that altar. Let the blood of Jesus neutralize every incantation spoken over that altar. Let the blood of Jesus break the backbone of every priest serving at that altar. Oh, the fire is falling. The fire is falling. I pray for your health right now. Somebody listening to me, there is a sickness in your body. And I want you to hear me clearly. That sickness is not a medical condition alone. There is a spiritual root. There is something feeding it from the dark realm. Maybe it came through a covenant. Maybe it came through a curse that was spoken. Maybe it came through food you ate in the dream. Maybe it came through a handshake, through a transaction, through something placed in your environment. I don't know how it came, but I know how it lives. It lives by the blood of Jesus. I speak to every infirmity in your body right now. Every sickness that has defied medication, every condition that keeps coming back after treatment, every disease that runs in your family line, every strange health issue that started suddenly without any natural explanation, I command you in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth by the power of the blood of the lamb, lose your hold and come out now. Come out of the blood, come out of the bones, come out of the organs, come out of the tissues. I speak healing by the blood of Jesus. I speak restoration by the blood of Jesus. I speak wholeness by the blood of Jesus. Isaiah chapter 53:5. By his stripes you are healed. Not you will be healed. You are healed. The price has already been paid. The blood has already been shed. All you need to do is receive it. And I release that healing into your body right now in the name of Jesus. Someone under the sound of my voice, you have been battling with fibroid and the doctors have recommended surgery. The Lord says to tell you, "My blood is your surgery. Before you go under the knife, go under the blood and watch what God will do." That fibroid is dissolving by the blood of Jesus. There is a man, I see this clearly, there is a man who has been dealing with a pain in his chest. They have done tests and they found nothing but the pain persists. The Lord is showing me that this is a spiritual arrow. It was fired in a dream. And tonight, the blood of Jesus pulls that arrow out of your chest. I pull it out by the blood. I extract it by the blood and I pour the blood of Jesus into the wound and I command healing in Jesus' name. Now, let me shift. I want to pray for your finances. The Bible says in Deuteronomy 8:18, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth." But there is something the enemy does. He places an embargo on the finances of God's children. He sets up spiritual roadblocks. He assigns monitoring spirits to ensure that every time money is about to come to you, something happens. The deal falls through, the contract is cancelled, the promotion goes to someone else, the business fails at the edge of breakthrough, and you sit there wondering, God, what is happening? I will tell you what is happening. There is a blood covenant in operation. Either one you made consciously or one that was made on your behalf. And that covenant has given the enemy legal access to your finances. But tonight, the blood of a better covenant speaks. I take the blood of Jesus and I apply it to your financial life right now. Every covenant of poverty break by the blood of Jesus. Every generational pattern of financial struggle, I terminate it by the blood of Jesus. Every spirit assigned to scatter your resources, I bind you by the blood of Jesus and I command you to release what you have stolen. I decree restitution by the blood. Seven times over, the enemy will return what he has taken. Proverbs 6:31, "But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold, he shall give all the substance of his house." I activate this scripture over your finances tonight. Every financial loss, every stolen opportunity, every diverted blessing, I decree a sevenfold return by the blood of Jesus. The gates of financial breakthrough are opening for you now. I see them swinging open. I see resources being released from places you never expected. I see men and women who have never helped you before suddenly becoming instruments of your blessing. I see doors opening in foreign lands. I see contracts being signed. I see businesses launching. I see debts being cancelled by the blood of Jesus. The financial siege is breaking. Michael, the Lord says that money you have been waiting for, it is on its way. The delay was not denial. There was a spirit holding it in transit. But the blood of Jesus has broken through and before this week ends you will see the manifestation. There is someone the Lord is showing me a woman and for years you have been the one paying all the bills. You have been the one carrying the financial burden of the family and it has become so heavy that you have started to lose hope. The Lord says to tell you help is coming. I am raising a helper for you. The blood of Jesus has broken the curse of lonely labor over your life. You will not carry this burden alone anymore. Now I want to pray for marriages. This is very important. Listen carefully. There are bloodlines where marriages do not work. Wherever you look in the family, marriages are collapsing. Divorces, separations, domestic violence, infidelity. It is not a coincidence. It is a pattern. And that pattern has a source. Somewhere in the ancestral line, a covenant was made that opened the door for a spirit of marital destruction. Malachi 2:16, for the Lord, the God of Israel, saith that he hated putting away. God hates divorce. God hates the destruction of what he has joined together. So if your marriage is under attack, understand that the attack is not from God. It is from the enemy. And the weapon we use tonight is the blood. I take the blood of Jesus and I apply it to every marriage represented in this gathering tonight. Every spirit of divorce, I bind you by the blood. Every spirit of misunderstanding, I cast you out by the blood. Every strange woman, every strange man assigned to destroy covenant marriages, I cut off your access by the blood of Jesus. Every marine spirit operating in marriages, husband spirits, wife spirits, spirits of lust and seduction and pornography and emotional disconnection. I command you all to bow before the blood of Jesus and release these marriages now. I speak peace into homes tonight. Where there has been war, let the blood speak peace. Where there has been silence, let the blood speak reconciliation. Where there has been bitterness, let the blood speak forgiveness. I decree that marriages will be restored. Couples who have separated will come back together. Love that has died will be resurrected by the power of the blood. Somebody you have been waiting for a life partner. Year after year, it seems like every promising relationship falls apart. Some of you have been told you will never marry. Some of you have been given spiritual diagnosis. There is a husband spirit on you. There is a padlock on your womb. There is a ring on your finger in the spirit realm. Let me tell you something tonight. All those things are real, but none of them can withstand the blood of Jesus. I take the blood of Jesus and I go to wherever those covenants were made. I go to the waters. I go to the altars. I go to the covens and I decree every spiritual marriage, I dissolve it by the blood of Jesus. Every ring placed on your finger in the dream, I remove it by the blood of Jesus. Every wedding garment worn in the spirit realm, I tear it off by the blood of Jesus. You are free. You are released and the right partner is coming to you. This year will not end without testimony in your marital life. Grace, the Lord says to tell you, stop crying. Your husband is closer than you think. The delay was a setup for the right connection. The blood has spoken. Prepare yourself. Now lift your voice. Pray with me in the spirit. Fire, fire, fire of the Holy Ghost. I want to address something now. Family deliverance. This is heavy. This is deep. But somebody needs to hear it tonight. There are families where there is a recurring pattern of untimely death. Young people dying in their prime, accidents, sudden illnesses, mysterious deaths, and the family just accepts it as the will of God. No. Let me tell you something tonight. It is not the will of God for your family to be a graveyard. Psalm 118:17, I shall not die, but leave and declare the works of the Lord. I speak to the spirit of untimely death over your family. You spirit of death that has been visiting this family line that has been collecting members of this family before their time, I stand against you tonight by the blood of Jesus. The blood of Jesus is upon the doorpost of this family. You cannot enter, you cannot collect, you cannot destroy. I cancel every appointment with death that the enemy has scheduled for any member of your family. By the blood of Jesus, you shall live and not die. There are families where there is a pattern of mental illness, depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, suicidal thoughts, and it passes from one generation to the next. That is not genetics. That is a spirit. And tonight I break it by the blood. Every spirit of insanity assigned to your bloodline, I uproot you by the blood of Jesus. Every cause of mental illness spoken over your family line, I revoke it by the blood. I declare soundness of mind over every member of your family. 2 Timothy 1:7. For God hath not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind. I activate this word over your family tonight. There are families where the children are weward. They don't serve God. They are in drugs, in alcohol, in the streets. The parents have cried and prayed and fasted and nothing seems to change. Hear me tonight. The blood of Jesus is going after your children. Isaiah 49:2. For I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children. God himself says, "I will save your children." So I release the blood of Jesus upon your children now. Every spirit holding your child in bondage, release them by the blood. Every influence of the wrong crowd, I break it by the blood. Every addiction, every destructive habit, every spirit of rebellion, I command you to bow before the blood and let these children go. There is a mother listening to me right now. Your son has not spoken to you in over a year. The Lord says before this month runs out, your phone will ring and it will be his voice on the other line. The blood is breaking the wall between you. Now, let me go deeper. I want to pray about stolen virtues and wasted time. This is prophetic. When the enemy cannot kill you, he delays you. When he cannot destroy your destiny, he wastes your time. He makes you spend years going in circles. He makes you labor without results. He makes you work hard and have nothing to show for it. Ecclesiastes chapter 9:1 says, "The race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong. Something is manipulating outcomes in the spirit realm." But Joel 2:2, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten, the canker worm, and the caterpillar, and the palmer worm. My great army which I sent among you, God is a restorer of time. God is a restorer of wasted years. And tonight, by the blood of Jesus, I am calling back your stolen years. Every year the enemy wasted, I call it back now by the blood. Every opportunity that was diverted, I summon it back by the blood. Every virtue that was siphoned in the dream, through sexual encounters in the night, through breastfeeding babies that are not yours in the dream, through eating food in the dream, through swimming in waters in the dream, I command every stolen virtue to be returned to you now by the fire of the Holy Ghost and by the blood of Jesus. I speak to your star, your star that was captured, your star that was buried, your star that was caged. I command it to arise and shine now for your light has come and the glory of the Lord is risen upon you. Isaiah 60:1, arise and shine. Not tomorrow, tonight, now by the blood of Jesus. Someone under the sound of my voice, I see a picture of a caged eagle. It represents your potential, your gift, your calling. And for years, it has been locked away. Somebody use witchcraft to cage your destiny. But I take the blood of Jesus tonight and I pour it upon that cage and I command the bars to melt. I command the locks to break. I command that eagle to fly. Saw rise. Take your place in the heavens in the name of Jesus Christ. The Lord says that job you lost was not a setback. It was a redirection. Something bigger is waiting. But the blood had to break the covenant that tied you to small things first. Now the door to the greater opens. Walk through it boldly. Amaka, the Lord says the shame is over. What happened to you in the past, the enemy has been using it to condemn you. But the blood of Jesus speaks louder than your past. There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus. Romans 8:1. The shame breaks tonight. Now I want to engage angelic intervention. Hebrews 1:14. Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation? There are angels assigned to your destiny. But some of them have been waiting for the legal ground to act. The blood is that legal ground. I release the blood of Jesus tonight as the legal tender for angelic activation. Every angel assigned to my life, assigned to your life, I invoke the blood and I commission you now. Go forth and fight. Go forth and arrange. Go forth and open doors. Go forth and dismantle every blockage. Go forth and bring the resources. Go forth and establish the connections. Go forth and guard the pathway. I release you by the blood of Jesus. Psalm 91:1. For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways. I activate angelic protection over your life, over your going out and your coming in, over your traveling, over your sleeping and your waking, over your children, over your spouse. No weapon formed against you shall prosper. Isaiah 54:1 17. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord and I enforce it by the blood. I speak to every witchcraft operation assigned against anyone hearing this message tonight. Every covenant meeting where your name has been mentioned, I scatter it by the blood. Every pot that has been set on fire against your destiny, I overturn it by the blood. Every mirror that has been used to monitor your life, I shatter it by the blood. Every broomstick, every calabash, every coffin prepared for you in the spirit realm, I set it ablaze by the blood of Jesus. Every witch, every wizard, every sorcerer, every necromancer, every marine agent assigned to your destiny, I decree the blood of Jesus is against you. Your assignment is terminated. Your power is broken. Your hold is destroyed. I release you from their grip in the mighty name of Jesus. The fire is burning. The chains are breaking. Can you feel it? Can you feel the weight lifting? Can you feel the heaviness leaving? That is the blood doing its work. That is the blood fighting for you. Now, let me speak to your destiny. Jeremiah 29:11. For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, sayeth the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil to give you an expected end. God has a plan for your life, a beautiful plan, a glorious plan. But the enemy also has a plan. And the two plans have been in conflict. The enemy's plan was to abort your purpose, to kill your vision, to bury your gift, to keep you in obscurity while mediocre people occupy your position. But I decree tonight the plan of the enemy is overruled by the blood. Your destiny is preserved by the blood. Your purpose is secured by the blood. Every hand that has been reaching for your throne, I cut it off by the blood. Every conspiracy to replace you, I dismantle it by the blood. Every plot to sideline you, I frustrate it by the blood. You will fulfill your destiny. You will reach your potential. You will touch your generation. You will leave a mark on this earth that cannot be erased. By the blood of Jesus, your destiny stands. I am hearing the Lord say something. Write this down. The Lord says this is your season of divine acceleration. What should have taken you 10 years, God is going to do in 10 months. What should have taken 5 years, God is going to do in 5 weeks. The blood has purchased speed for you. The blood has purchased acceleration. You are entering into a dimension of supernatural speed where results will come so fast that people around you will be confused. They will say, "How did this happen?" And you will point to the blood. You will point to the cross. You will point to Jesus. Psalm 102:13, "Thou shalt arise and have mercy upon Zion, for the time to favor her. Yay, the set time is come." The set time is now, not next year, not next season, now. Tonight. By the authority invested in me as a servant of the most high God, I decree your set time has come. Favor is locating you. Promotion is finding you. Breakthrough is surrounding you. The blood has spoken. And what the blood says cannot be reversed. Numbers 23:20. Behold, I have received commandment to bless and he had blessed and I cannot reverse it. No one can reverse what the blood has established. No cause can override what the blood has spoken. No spell can undo what the blood has done. You are blessed. You are favored. You are protected. You are preserved. David, the Lord says that contract is going to be signed. Do not fear the delay. The blood has already written your name on it. There is someone who has been trying to leave the country and every visa application has been denied. The Lord says the spirit that was blocking your movement is dismantled tonight by the blood. The next time you apply, the answer will be yes. Not because of your bank statement, not because of your papers, but because the blood has spoken in the embassy before you arrive. Precious, the Lord says the baby is coming. I know they told you your womb was damaged. I know the report says conception is impossible, but the Lord says, "Is there anything too hard for me?" Genesis 18:14, "The blood of Jesus is entering your womb tonight and repairing what was damaged by this time. In the coming year, you will carry your own child. Receive it. Hold it in your heart. Do not let doubt steal this word." Now, let me seal this. Every word that has been spoken tonight, I seal it with the blood of Jesus. Every prayer that has been prayed, I seal it with the blood. Every decree that has been declared, I seal it with the blood. I place the blood of Jesus upon your head. I place the blood of Jesus upon your hands. I place the blood of Jesus upon your feet. I place the blood of Jesus upon your home. I place the blood of Jesus upon your family. I place the blood of Jesus upon your finances. I place the blood of Jesus upon your health. I place the blood of Jesus upon your marriage. I place the blood of Jesus upon your children. I place the blood of Jesus upon your career. I place the blood of Jesus upon your ministry. I place the blood of Jesus upon your going out and your coming in from this day forward and forever. Yes, Lord. Yes, Lord. I receive it. We receive it. The siege is over. I need you to hear me. Whatever siege you have been under, whether it was financial, whether it was marital, whether it was health related, whether it was spiritual, the siege breaks tonight by the blood of Jesus. The walls of Jericho are falling. The gates of brass are broken. The bars of iron are caught in sunder. Psalm 107:16. For he had broken the gates of brass and cut the bars of iron in sunder. You are walking into a new season. A season of open doors, a season of unusual favor, a season of answered prayers, a season of testimonies that will make your enemies ashamed. A season where everything the enemy stole will come back to you multiplied. The blood of Jesus has fought for you tonight and the blood has won. I want you to begin to thank God right now. Open your mouth and give him praise. Give him glory. Give him honor. The battle was not yours. The battle was the Lord's. 2 Chronicles 20:15. And he fought with his blood and he won with his blood and you are the beneficiary of that victory. This week is your testimony. I say it again. This week is your testimony. Something is going to happen this week that will confirm everything God has spoken over your life tonight. Watch for it. Be expectant. When it happens, come back and testify. Let the world know that the blood of Jesus is still powerful. The blood of Jesus is still active. The blood of Jesus still speaks. Thank you, Lord. Thank you, precious Holy Spirit. Thank you, Jesus, for your blood. We are eternally grateful. We will never take the blood for granted. We will plead it every day. We will apply it every morning. We will speak it over our lives, over our families, over our cities, over our nations. The blood of Jesus Christ, the son of the living God, has prevailed tonight. It is finished. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. And all of God's people said, "Amen and amen and amen." Go in the power of the blood. Go in the victory of the blood. Go and walk in the fullness of everything the blood has purchased for you. Your life will never remain the same. I decree it. I declare it. I seal it in the matchless, undefeable, allconquering name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. The blood has spoken and it is
